privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.location: Your location is used only to find places near you. Before it leaves your phone, we round it to about 100 meters (300 feet). Your exact location is never saved. There are no accounts, ads, or trackers.
privacy.servers: To find places, the rounded location goes to OpenStreetMap's free map servers. They also send the map pictures for the area you're looking at. If you type a place, it goes to OpenStreetMap's search service. If you ask for walking directions, the rounded start and the place go to a free routing server run by the same volunteers.
privacy.device: Places you save and recent search results are kept on this phone, so the app works without internet. To offer your last results offline, it also remembers roughly where you last searched (within about 1 km). All of this is deleted after 7 days, and you can delete it any time below.
privacy.history: Your browser's history may still show that you visited this website.
offline.banner: You're offline. Showing your last results.
offline.welcome: You're offline. You can still see places from your last search.

location.help.inApp: This link opened inside another app, which blocks location. Tap the menu (the … or share icon) and choose “Open in Safari” or “Open in Chrome”, then try again.
location.help.ios: iPhone: open Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services and turn it On. Then tap Safari Websites (or your browser) and choose While Using the App. Come back and reload this page.
location.help.android: Android: open Settings → Location and turn it On. Then in Chrome, tap the lock icon next to the address, choose Permissions → Location → Allow, and reload this page.
location.help.other: Open your browser's settings for this site, set Location to Allow, and reload this page.
